news.title: European-Japanese BepiColombo probe arrives in orbit around Mercury today
paras: The BepiColombo mission — a joint effort of the European Space Agency (ESA) and the Japanese Aerospace Exploration Agency ( JAXA ) — will arrive in orbit around Mercury today (Nov. 21), more than eight years after leaving its home planet. The big moment will come after an orbit-insertion burn, which is scheduled to begin today at 1:24 p.m.

EST (1824 GMT) and last for 37 minutes. BepiColombo consists of two main spacecraft: ESA's Mercury Planetary Orbiter (MPO) and JAXA's Mercury Magnetospheric Orbiter (MMO), also known as Mio. Mercury is a difficult planet to reach because it's so close to the sun .

sport.title: Brad Gilbert has a theory for why Carlos Alcaraz is getting injured so much, ‘not everyone can be like Federer
paras: Carlos Alcaraz has endured an injury-riddled year, which has seen him miss more than four months of competitive action. His absence from the ATP Tour left a massive vacuum, with Alexander Zverev the generous beneficiary to his faltering fitness.

Despite the hardships endured after spending so long on the sidelines, many did predict that the Spaniard could use this rest time to return reinvigorated at the end of the season . Winning titles in Tokyo, Vienna and Paris has certainly proven that suggestion correct. Who do you think is now taking home the ATP Finals title?

sport.title: Daniil Medvedev responds when asked if he doubted whether he would ever get back to where he is now
paras: Daniil Medvedev has been on a resurgence in the 2026 season, which he has continued at the ATP Finals. Medvedev had a disappointing season by his standards last year, having dropped to as low as world number 18 and therefore failed to qualify for the ATP Finals for the first time since 2018.

There were questions over whether Medvedev, who is a former world number one, would be able to get back near to his previous best, but he has proven that he is not quite finished yet. After beating Tiafoe to secure his place in the last-four of the ATP Finals, Medvedev was asked if he ever had doubts about whether he would be able to get himself back to this point.

It has been an outstanding season for the Italian, and his qualification at this prestigious end-of-year event felt wholly justified. Sadly, the jump was just too high on this occasion, though the experience should only fuel him to return reinvigorated in the future. Who do you think is now taking home the ATP Finals title?

sport.title: November 21, 1999: The day Lindsay Davenport defeated Martina Hingis to win the season-ending WTA Championship
paras: Every day, Tennis Majors looks back to the biggest moments in tennis history. On November 21, 1999, Martina Hingis’ era of dominance came to an end at the hands of Lindsay Davenport

On this day, November 21, 1999, Lindsay Davenport defeated Martina Hingis 6-4, 6-2 in the final of what was then called the WTA Chase Championships, the women’s season-ending event. This match was more evidence of Hingis’ struggles against an upcoming generation of very powerful players. The “Swiss Miss”, aged only 19, had already won five Grand Slam titles, but she would never manage to lift another major trophy, despite three consecutive finals reached at the Australian Open (2000-2002).
